## Procedure

1. Inhale, taking a deep breath to fill the chest with air, and engage the core to prevent the back from arching to complete the lift
2. Lower the dumbbells slowly and under control keeping the upper arms 45° to the torso (-70)
3. Drive the weight off the chest extending the elbows to return the dumbbells to the starting position
4. Exhale as you near the top of the lift

## Coaching Points

- Wrists should be in line with elbows
- The most common error is letting the dumbbells and hands go wider than the elbows (i.e., the forearms should not go wider than perpendicular to the ground)
- The lower back should remain in contact with the bench throughout the entire lift (do not arch the back or raise the chest to complete the lift)
